title: Swift MT101 Coexistence Readiness Diff
description: Evaluates Swift CBPR+ MT101 message-type retirement readiness ahead of the 2026-11-14 coexistence deadline, when FI-to-FI bulk/multiple payment initiation drops MT101 (FIN) in favor of pain.001v9 (ISO 20022 MX). Declare the message format currently in production and a structural self-declared readiness checklist and get a deterministic ready/not-ready verdict plus days to deadline. Client-side, deterministic, zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: check_mt101_coexistence_readiness
mcp_tool_definition.description: Evaluates Swift CBPR+ MT101 message-type retirement readiness (coexistence deadline 2026-11-14, FI-to-FI bulk/multiple payment initiation) from a caller-declared current message format (MT101 or pain.001v9) and a structural self-declared readiness checklist. Returns a deterministic ready/not-ready verdict, days_to_deadline computed from a fixed deadline constant and a caller-supplied as_of_date, and named readiness gaps. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/tools/577-mt101-coexistence-readiness-diff.html for interactive use.

currentMessageFormat.description: Message format currently in production for FI-to-FI bulk/multiple payment initiation: "MT101" or "pain.001v9"

asOfDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) to evaluate readiness as of

emitsPain001v9Bulk.description: True if the sender's system already emits pain.001v9 for bulk FI-to-FI (only relevant when currentMessageFormat is pain.001v9)

fallbackPathStaged.description: True if a fallback pain.001v9 path is staged (only relevant when currentMessageFormat is MT101)

correspondentConfirmedReceipt.description: True if the correspondent has confirmed it can receive pain.001v9 (only relevant when currentMessageFormat is MT101)
